scripts.text: [Keegan]

scripts.translation: 那麼，{0}，想接任務的話，就去隔壁房間找那位尋寶者同伴。

scripts.text: [Keegan]
Sorry you must be a member of the Treasure Hunter Guild if you wish to take a quest.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，只有尋寶者公會會員才能接取任務。

scripts.text: Also now that you are a member feel free to use our shops anytime you wish.They are all located on this floor.
scripts.translation: 另外，既然你已成為會員，歡迎隨時使用我們的商店。它們都在這一層。

scripts.text: We also have another shop for members only,in which we use little metal diamonds called Treasure Hunter Tokens to exchange for rare goods.
scripts.translation: 我們還有一家會員專屬商店，可以用小型金屬鑽石——尋寶者代幣——兌換稀有商品。

scripts.text: You will even have access to our exclusive personal Dungeon.
scripts.translation: 你還可以進入我們的專屬私人地下城。

scripts.text: [Keegan]
Yes {0} I will take you to our shop right away!
scripts.translation: 好的，{0}，我馬上帶你去商店！

scripts.text: [Keegan]
I'm sorry only members may visit our private shop.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，只有會員才能進入我們的私人商店。
